clips.title: The story
paras: At his camp by the Zoram Strand, Talen searches for kaldorei relics along the coast. Nearby naga and Horde outposts make the work dangerous.

At a camp beside the Zoram Strand, Talen studies the past instead of taking up arms. Naga and Horde outposts make the coast dangerous, but he keeps searching the ruins beneath the waves and sands for lost kaldorei relics. He depends on travelers to face the Wrathtail naga and recover artifacts, including pristine statuettes and the Ring of Zoram, held by their leader Ruuzel.
